title: Preflight flux snapshot and KPI pledge
content:
Purpose: quick, shareable snapshot for the go/no-go window (T-14 -> T+72h). This is intentionally compact: a rolling KPI pledge (owner commits) + a short operational checklist for first responders. Treat this file as the canonical small-screen brief for execs and oncall.

Topline summary (T-7 status):
- Release: 2026-02 internal pilot -> public beta (phased)
- Primary SLOs: median p50 latency < 150ms for hosted-api; error rate < 0.5% sustained; cost/unit target $0.0025/token avg
- Current risk tier: amber (capacity headroom borderline for region eu-west-1 at expected 2x spike)

KPI pledge (rolling):
Columns: KPI | Target | Current | Delta (since last) | Owner | Escalation
1) API median latency (text-gen, 2k seq) |  <=150ms | 162ms | +12ms | Jamal Chen | eng-sre oncall -> page
2) 99th latency (text-gen) | <=350ms | 410ms | +60ms | Francesca Moretti | perf-team runbook
3) Token success rate (per-request) | >=99.5% | 99.62% | -0.05% | Liam O'Connor | customer-success notify
4) Cost per 1k tokens (weighted) | <=$2.50 | $2.31 | -$0.06 | Aisha Patel | finance alert
5) Onboarded beta customers (week1) | 50 | 12 | +2 | Solutions Eng | sales-engage

Short readiness checklist (T-1 & T-0 quick checks):
- [ ] Canary route live and returning golden-test prompts (team: eng-serving-runtime)
- [ ] Auto-fallback policy validated (hosted -> dedicated) with synthetic failover (S: eng-platform)
- [ ] Capacity burst pre-allocated in eu-west-1 (ops ticket JIRA-OPS-789)
- [ ] Observability retention tags attached to beta customer tokens
- [ ] Support playbook drafted + first responder roster shared to slack:#prod-ops
- [ ] Billing throttle thresholds set and verified (finance + infra)

Contingency knobs (fast toggles):
- Soft cap per-customer tokens -> enforced at API gateway (deploy config id: gateway-2026-02-08)
- Route split -> 80/20 to dedicated variant (auto-promote after health + steady tokens)
- Quality fallback -> quantized v2, lower inference cost and lower throughput expectation

Risks & mitigations (quick bullets):
- Risk: regional GPU shortage if unexpected spike -> Mitigation: trigger cross-region spill with sticky-session TTL 30s and pre-warmed KV cache (ops runbook section 3)
- Risk: regression in hallucination rate on new model -> Mitigation: blocklist and rapid rollback via pinned-version toggles + evaluation harness (confluence: CONFLUENCE-PRD-8421)
- Risk: support overload first 24h -> Mitigation: expand oncall to include solutions-eng and set canned-response library

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self style):
- Can we move eu-west burst from reserved -> burst pool without impacting other customers? (ask infra by 2026-02-11)
- Need a short A/B prompt test to validate latency/quality tradeoff for quantized v2
- Confirm export of token-level cost telemetry to finance daily digest

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Jamal: run 3x synthetic spike tests and post summary (ETA: 2026-02-12)
- Francesca: finalize 99th lat gating thresholds and add to alerting (ETA: 2026-02-11)
- Liam: prepare support FAQ and mapping to escalation (ETA: 2026-02-12)
- Aisha: finalize stakeholder one-pager and send to GTM + exec (ETA: 2026-02-10)

Cheat notes / shorthand:
- "pledge" = owner commit to get KPI back within target within 24h of breach
- Use label "preflight:flux" on related tickets
- If amber -> trigger steering call; if red -> escalate to CTO + all-hands for 1hr cadence

Recent edits: trimmed cost model, added token-level success rate metric, swapped owner for latency KPI. File intended as living doc through T+72h.
